title: Litigation Office L-02
audience: regional business owners facing an active commercial dispute
in-house counsel evaluating local trial support
pageJob: Establish precise, calm litigation capability and route a qualified visitor into a confidential matter-review request without promising an outcome or implying an attorney-client relationship.

facts.statement: The fictional firm handles commercial disputes in two unnamed neighboring state jurisdictions.
The fictional team consists of four partners, three associates, and two litigation support specialists.
Matter categories are contract disputes, shareholder conflicts, emergency injunctions, and trial support.
A submitted request is reviewed within one business day but does not create an attorney-client relationship.
The firm must complete a conflicts check before receiving detailed confidential documents.
No case outcomes, win rates, rankings, awards, or client names are available for this fixture.

constraints: Do not claim guaranteed outcomes, rankings, awards, verdict totals, or client logos.
Do not request detailed privileged documents in the first-contact form.
The interface must remain calm and credible without defaulting to a generic serious-serif template.
Keyboard focus and form errors are shipping gates.

assetPolicy.instruction: Use benchmark-authored typography, document grammar, procedural diagrams, and CSS; no courthouse, gavel, portrait, or stock imagery is available.

shippingBudgets.accessibilityTarget: WCAG 2.2 AA practical floor; conformance requires complete evidence
